taxonomy.note: Elevated to species rank in 2023; Passiflora foetida var. lanuginosa is a synonym.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew native range is eastern Mexico to Guatemala; Texas is not native range.
target_zone_range.guardrail: San Antonio/Bexar observations can represent introduced populations and must not be counted as Texas-native evidence.

morphology.look_here_first: Use as an introduced lookalike comparison. Compared with native P. foetida, plants tend to have darker more angular pointed leaves, pinker flowers, and smooth fruits that ripen red.
diagnostic_traits: introduced passionflower in parts of Texas
leaves darker and more angular/pointed than native P. foetida
fruit smooth and red at maturity
can be vigorous/spreading in disturbed habitat
